probe_detail.name: Generalizes the method beyond the specific numbers
Answers the question that was actually asked

final.name: Intuition tied to formal meaning
final.audit_justification: Whether an analogy is actually tied back to the formal content is a substantive judgment about the explanatory value of the answer.

final.name: Notational Discipline and Consistency
final.audit_justification: Notational cleanliness is a formatting/typography trait, though a careful writer could plausibly also produce more correct mathematics.
final.arbiter_reason: The criterion's object is the mathematics itself -- whether symbols are standard and used consistently -- which is domain craft, not typography: reusing or improvising notation is a genuine defect in a mathematical argument. The 'well-formatted' clause adds a thin format component, but a judge scoring this instruction would mostly be reporting on the discipline of the math being presented.

final.name: Decisive counterexample construction
final.audit_justification: Whether a counterexample actually verifies the hypothesis and demonstrates failure is direct evidence of mathematical correctness.

final.name: Explicit cross-reference to other answers or comments
final.audit_justification: Presence of explicit cross-referencing is a social/stylistic pattern, though building on others' work could plausibly reflect genuine added value.

final.name: Invites reader dialogue or explicitly requests feedback
final.audit_justification: Inviting reader feedback is a rhetorical address pattern unrelated to the substance of the mathematics offered.
final.arbiter_reason: A judge scoring this instruction counts direct-address moves at the end of the post, which is a rhetorical form detectable without reading any of the mathematics. The criterion also conflates comprehension checks with soliciting help for one's own broken post, so there is no single upstream cause that plausibly generates genuine answer quality.

final.name: Domain and exception discipline
final.audit_justification: Correctly tracking domains and restrictions is a direct measure of mathematical rigor and correctness.

final.name: Revision trace markers
final.audit_justification: Presence of edit/repair markers is a template/boilerplate trace, though the underlying revision process could plausibly have improved the content.

final.name: Vintage of notation and markup conventions
final.audit_justification: This explicitly scores dated markup and typographic conventions, a pure temporal/orthographic fingerprint with no plausible link to correctness.
final.upstream_parent: the era of the site the post comes from (post vintage)

final.name: Dense structured mathematical display
final.audit_justification: Volume of display-mode formatting is a typographic trait, though heavier structured derivations could plausibly coincide with more rigorous work.
final.upstream_parent: author's markup habit / practice with site conventions

final.name: Transparent Limitation Acknowledgment
final.audit_justification: Honestly flagging genuine limitations while remaining useful speaks to the substantive reliability of the answer's claims.

final.name: Generalizable method extraction
final.audit_justification: Whether a reusable strategy is identified and justified is a substantive property of the mathematical content.

final.name: Structure-revealing transformation
final.audit_justification: Explaining a structure-revealing transformation is direct mathematical insight, not a surface trait.

final.name: Cross-Method Verification
final.audit_justification: Independent verification via multiple methods is direct evidence of correctness and thoroughness.

final.name: Sustained second-person address to this asker
final.audit_justification: Second-person address style is a voice/register marker, though sustained tailoring to the asker could plausibly reflect genuinely more responsive content.
final.arbiter_reason: The 5 and 0 anchors define the scale purely by how much second-person voice runs through the text, so a judge applying it produces a register measurement even though the 10 anchor bundles in real responsiveness (adopting the asker's framing, anticipating their next confusion). Mixed because that bundled tailoring is a plausible upstream cause of genuinely more useful answers.

final.name: Names a canonical object as a load-bearing shortcut, not as trivia
final.audit_justification: Whether a named theorem actually does load-bearing work versus decoration is a substantive judgment about the argument's efficiency and correctness.

final.name: Formal/technical machinery calibrated to the question's apparent level
final.audit_justification: Whether the level of formal machinery is well matched to the question is a substantive judgment about the answer's appropriateness and quality.

final.name: Display-math volume share
final.audit_justification: Display-math volume share is explicitly a visual/typographic measure, though heavier formal display could plausibly coincide with more careful derivation.

final.name: Hint-mode withholding versus delivered completion
final.audit_justification: This scores only the extent of withholding versus completion, an explicitly non-evaluative structural trait, though a fuller worked argument could plausibly also be higher quality.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's habitual pedagogical practice in this format and the homework-answering norms they were socialised into

final.name: Answer length/verbosity
final.audit_justification: Duplicate of the length/verbosity channel, which is incidental though could plausibly track genuine thoroughness.

final.name: Orthographic slips and informal typing hygiene
final.audit_justification: Orthographic slips and typing hygiene are surface production errors explicitly decoupled from mathematical correctness.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's language background and how much composition care the post received

final.name: Direct second-person address to asker
final.audit_justification: Direct second-person address is a stylistic voice marker, though tailoring to the asker's specific error could plausibly reflect genuinely more useful content.
final.upstream_parent: answerer's relationship to the reader (writing for the asker vs. for future searchers)

final.name: Hint hands back a specific next action rather than a formula
final.audit_justification: Whether a hint gives the asker an actionable, staged next step versus a bare unconnected formula is a substantive judgment about the pedagogical/mathematical usefulness of the content.

final.name: Self-contained completion
final.audit_justification: Whether the answer reaches the requested conclusion with all necessary steps is a direct measure of completeness and substance.

final.name: Insight density relative to length
final.audit_justification: The ratio of genuine insight to padding is a substantive judgment about the mathematical content's value, not a surface trait.

final.name: Diagnosing the asker's posted attempt versus standalone exposition
final.audit_justification: Mode of address (diagnosing a specific attempt vs. standalone exposition) is explicitly scored without judging which is better, though diagnostic engagement could plausibly reflect genuinely more tailored help.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's relationship to the reader (writing for the asker versus for future searchers), which is itself set by whether the question posted a visible attempt
